s = input()

def check(s):
    if s[0] == '.':
        s = "dot" + s[1:]
    elif s[0] == '@':
        s = "at" + s[1:]
    if s[-1] == '.':
        s = s[:-1] + "dot"
    elif s[-1] == '@':
        s = s[:-1] + "at"
    return s

N = len(s)
solve = ""
I = 0
while I < N:
    if I + 3 <= N and s[I:I+3] == "dot":
        solve += "."
        I += 3
    elif I + 2 <= N and s[I:I+2] == "at":
        solve += "@"
        I += 2
    else:
        solve += s[I]
        I += 1

solve = check(solve)

cont = solve.count('@')

if cont == 1:
    print(solve)
else:
    ok = True
    result = ""
    for ch in solve:
        if ch == '@':
            if ok:
                result += '@'
                ok = False
            else:
                result += "at"
        else:
            result += ch
    print(result)
